svg.text: The Martingale Progression: Exponential Risk vs Fixed Return
Why doubling bets after losses inevitably encounters table limits or catastrophic loss.
Loss 1: ₹1,000 | Total Risked: ₹1,500 | Net Win If Hit: ₹500
Loss 2: ₹2,000 | Total Risked: ₹3,500 | Net Win If Hit: ₹500
Loss 3: ₹4,000 | Total Risked: ₹7,500 | Net Win If Hit: ₹500
Loss 6: ₹32,000 | Total Risked: ₹63,500 | Net Win If Hit: ₹500
Loss 8: ₹1,28,000 | Total Risked: ₹2,55,500 | Hits Table Maximum Limit!
A streak of 7 consecutive opposite outcomes occurs once every 128 cycles (far more common than intuitive prediction).
